rust_summary: video on a surface in the world, played by a libmpv the mod declares (`native_video_open`, `native_draw_video`).
doc_summary: video in the world (docs/native-libraries.md): `native_video_open(path, width, height, looped)` plays a local file with the libmpv the mod declared in `native-libraries.toml` and returns a surface, `native_draw_video(draw, video, corners)` draws its current frame on a quad from `native_block_entity_submit`, and `native_video_load`, `native_video_pause`, `native_video_seek`, `native_video_volume`, `native_video_close` and `native_video_state` drive and read it. mpv plays the sound itself. Bundles need "hooks": @API:world_video@.
